# Know Your Meme

> > Encyclopedia and documentation hub for viral internet memes, trends, and online culture phenomena.

Know Your Meme tracks and explains the origins, evolution, and cultural impact of memes across platforms like TikTok, Twitter, YouTube, and other social media. The site features comprehensive entries on viral trends, image macros, catchphrases, and internet culture moments with historical context and spread documentation.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Viral catchphrases and dance trends
- Twitter/X meme culture
- YouTube viral content
- Hood movie nostalgia memes
- Breaking Bad references
- DeviantArt and fan art memes
- Heartbreaking and emotional memes
- Cat memes and animal content
- Accuracy reenactment trends
- 90s nostalgia culture
- Rap song-based memes
- Facebook and Pinterest sharing

## TikTok Viral Trends

- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' song catchphrase
- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring art of girl & cat, viral on TikTok & Twitter
